name: threejs-devtools-mcp
description: Inspect Three.js / React Three Fiber scenes, live-preview tweaks in the browser and turn them into code. Website audits, video frame capture, Playwright helpers — 69 tools.

tools.name: scene_tree
tools.description: Scene hierarchy (inspect)

tools.name: object_details
tools.description: Detailed info about one object by name, uuid, or dot path (inspect)

tools.name: find_objects
tools.description: Search objects by type, material, visibility, name pattern, or custom property (inspect)

tools.name: raycast
tools.description: Cast a ray from the camera through screen coordinates and return hit objects (inspect)

tools.name: click_inspect
tools.description: Click-to-inspect: the cursor becomes a crosshair — tell the user to click an object in the 3D view (inspect)

tools.name: scene_diff
tools.description: Compare scene state over time: first call saves a snapshot, next call lists added/removed/modified objects (inspect)

tools.name: layer_details
tools.description: Camera layer mask and objects with non-default layers (inspect)

tools.name: set_object_transform
tools.description: Set position, rotation, scale, or visibility of an object (live preview)

tools.name: set_layers
tools.description: Set layers on an object or the camera (live preview)

tools.name: material_list
tools.description: All materials in the scene with type, color, transparency (inspect)

tools.name: material_details
tools.description: Full material properties: colors, PBR/physical params, maps, uniforms, defines, NodeMaterial (TSL) slots (inspect)

tools.name: shader_list
tools.description: Compiled shader programs with their materials (WebGL) (inspect)

tools.name: shader_source
tools.description: Vertex/fragment GLSL source and uniforms of a material (inspect)

tools.name: texture_list
tools.description: All textures: size, format, wrap, filter settings (inspect)

tools.name: texture_details
tools.description: Detailed info about one texture (inspect)

tools.name: texture_preview
tools.description: Show a texture as a PNG image (inspect)

tools.name: set_material_property
tools.description: Set a material property (live preview)

tools.name: set_uniform
tools.description: Set a ShaderMaterial uniform (live preview)

tools.name: set_texture
tools.description: Change texture sampling and transform: wrap, filter, anisotropy, repeat, offset, rotation, colorSpace (live preview)

tools.name: shadow_details
tools.description: Shadow maps: global settings, per-light bias/mapSize/camera frustum, casters and receivers (inspect)

tools.name: scene_background
tools.description: Scene background, environment map (IBL), backgroundBlurriness/Intensity, color management (inspect)

tools.name: env_map_details
tools.description: Environment maps: scene.environment, scene.background, per-material envMap (inspect)

tools.name: fog_details
tools.description: Scene fog: type (Fog/FogExp2), color, near/far or density (inspect)

tools.name: set_light
tools.description: Change a light: color, intensity, position, castShadow, groundColor (HemisphereLight) (live preview)

tools.name: set_shadow
tools.description: Change shadow casting/receiving on any object, and bias/mapSize/shadow camera on lights (live preview)

tools.name: set_fog
tools.description: Change scene fog (color, near/far or density) and the background color (live preview)

tools.name: camera_details
tools.description: Active camera: type, position, FOV, near/far, aspect (inspect)

tools.name: renderer_info
tools.description: Renderer stats and backend (WebGL / WebGPU): draw calls, triangles, memory, capabilities (inspect)

tools.name: renderer_settings
tools.description: Renderer configuration: toneMapping, exposure, colorSpace, shadowMap, pixelRatio (inspect)

tools.name: clipping_details
tools.description: Clipping planes: renderer global, per-material, ClippingGroup objects (inspect)

tools.name: postprocessing_list
tools.description: EffectComposer passes: render passes, shader passes, effects (bloom, SSAO, …) (inspect)

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Change the active camera: position, rotation, FOV, near/far, zoom, ortho bounds (live preview)

tools.name: set_renderer
tools.description: Change renderer settings: tone mapping, exposure, color space, pixel ratio, shadows (live preview)

tools.name: set_clipping
tools.description: Change clipping planes on the renderer (global) or a material (live preview)

tools.name: set_postprocessing
tools.description: Enable/disable passes, set pass uniforms or effect parameters (live preview)

tools.name: geometry_details
tools.description: Geometry of a mesh: vertices, attributes, index, bounding box, morph attributes (inspect)

tools.name: instanced_mesh_details
tools.description: InstancedMesh: count, capacity, sample transforms, instance colors and custom attributes (inspect)

tools.name: batched_mesh_details
tools.description: BatchedMesh: geometry counts, draw ranges, instance visibility (inspect)

tools.name: morph_targets
tools.description: Meshes with morph targets: target names and current influences (inspect)

tools.name: skeleton_details
tools.description: Skeletons and bones of SkinnedMesh objects (inspect)

tools.name: animation_details
tools.description: AnimationMixers with their actions, clips, weights and playback state (inspect)

tools.name: set_instanced_mesh
tools.description: Change InstancedMesh count, visibility, frustumCulled (live preview)

tools.name: set_morph_target
tools.description: Set a morph target influence (live preview)

tools.name: set_animation
tools.description: Control playback: mixer timeScale/time, action play/stop/pause/weight by clip name (live preview)

tools.name: web_audit
tools.description: Website health check: pixel ratio, canvas resize, idle/off-screen rendering, antialias cost, oversized or uncompressed textures, shadow cost, color space, draw calls (inspect)

tools.name: performance_snapshot
tools.description: Draw calls, triangles, instanced meshes, object counts by type (inspect)

tools.name: perf_monitor
tools.description: Record FPS and frame times for N seconds: avg/min/max, percentiles, spikes, jank (inspect)

tools.name: draw_call_breakdown
tools.description: Per-object draw call and triangle cost, sorted by cost (inspect)

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: GPU memory: geometry buffers, texture VRAM, instance data, top textures by size (inspect)

tools.name: dispose_check
tools.description: Leak detection: geometries/textures tracked by the renderer but no longer in the scene (inspect)

tools.name: console_capture
tools.description: Recent browser console output (log/warn/error) (inspect)

tools.name: toggle_overlay
tools.description: In-browser inspector panel: live FPS, draw calls, scene tree, materials, lights (debug visual)

tools.name: overlay_selected
tools.description: Everything about the object the user selected in the overlay: materials, geometry, transforms, textures, uniforms, shadows (inspect)

tools.name: highlight_object
tools.description: Highlight an object with wireframe, or toggle its visibility, to point it out (debug visual)

tools.name: toggle_wireframe
tools.description: Wireframe on all materials or one object (debug visual)

tools.name: bounding_boxes
tools.description: Show/hide bounding boxes — debug frustum culling and object bounds (debug visual)

tools.name: add_helper
tools.description: Add a debug helper to an object: box, axes, skeleton, arrow, grid, camera frustum, light helpers, plane (debug visual)

tools.name: remove_helper
tools.description: Remove a helper added with add_helper (debug visual)

tools.name: run_js
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page with scene, renderer, camera, gl in scope; `return` a value to get it back (debug visual)

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the current scene (also saved as PNG in screenshots/) (inspect)

tools.name: annotated_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot with object names drawn at their screen positions ([M]esh, [L]ight, [G]roup, [C]amera) (inspect)

tools.name: capture_frames
tools.description: Record a frame sequence for a video (inspect)

tools.name: scene_export
tools.description: Export the scene or one object as GLB/glTF into screenshots/ (inspect)

tools.name: pending_changes
tools.description: Everything changed with live-preview tools since the last clear: before → after per property, plus ready-to-paste code (vanilla Three.js and/or React Three Fiber) and where to find each target (for code)

tools.name: revert_changes
tools.description: Undo live-preview changes in the browser (all, or selected ids from pending_changes), newest first (live preview)

tools.name: gltf_to_r3f
tools.description: Convert a GLB/glTF file into a React Three Fiber component (like gltfjsx) (for code)

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Bridge connection, proxy target, and how to attach Playwright to the same browser (connection)

tools.name: set_dev_port
tools.description: Point the proxy at another local dev server port (connection)

tools.name: set_dev_url
tools.description: Inspect a remote Three.js app by URL (connection)
